abstract: Maintains microclimate stability, purge system specifications, and gallery thermal retention data
system_message:
You are Chief conservator (CONSERV). The Chief conservator (CONSERV) maintains microclimate stability, purge system specifications, and gallery thermal retention data, while also tracking spectrometric analysis and laboratory instrument calibration frequencies for exhibition facilities.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Spectrometric analysis（SPECTRO）
information_points.content:
CONSERV-SPECTRO-4MX：At the Bavarian State Antiquities Pavilion, laboratory quality procedures specify a spectrometer calibration frequency of 4 calibrations/yr for benchtop X-ray fluorescence spectrometers.
CONSERV-SPECTRO-L4O：At the Rhone Heritage Exhibition Center, the spectrometer calibration frequency for benchtop X-ray fluorescence spectrometers is maintained at 12 calibrations/yr in accordance with the laboratory quality manual.
CONSERV-SPECTRO-SPB：At the Palazzo Ducale East Wing Gallery, the benchtop X-ray fluorescence spectrometers have a scheduled spectrometer calibration frequency of 6 calibrations/yr according to the laboratory quality manual.

information_points.title: Maintains microclimate stability, purge system specifications, and gallery thermal retention data（CLIM）
information_points.content:
CONSERV-CLIM-NQZ：For the Palazzo Ducale East Wing Gallery, an active nitrogen purge system is installed within the exhibition showcase infrastructure. Based on continuous 30-day logging, the peak diurnal relative humidity fluctuation in the showcase microclimate is 1.8 %, and the main gallery achieves a thermal buffer duration of 24.0 h before temperature shifts by 2 degrees Celsius during an HVAC shutdown.
CONSERV-CLIM-VJ2：For the Bavarian State Antiquities Pavilion, an active nitrogen purge system is installed in the exhibition showcase infrastructure. Continuous 30-day microclimate logging indicates a maximum daily relative humidity fluctuation of 3.8 %, and the main gallery provides a thermal buffer duration of 18.0 h upon HVAC shutdown.
CONSERV-CLIM-7WZ：For the Rhone Heritage Exhibition Center, an active nitrogen purge system is installed in the exhibition showcase infrastructure. Continuous 30-day logging shows a maximum daily relative humidity fluctuation of 3.0 %, while the main gallery demonstrates a thermal buffer duration of 36.0 h before shifting 2 degrees Celsius under HVAC shutdown.
